## Emerald 2.3.0-dev.2

This prerelease fixes code-block copying in Edit Mode and the Linux AppImage
process name. It retains the reading-position and navigation improvements from
`2.3.0-dev.1`.

### Code-block copying

- The copy button in Edit Mode now copies the complete code block, including
  lines below the viewport, without the Markdown fences.
- Indentation, blank lines, and Unicode text are preserved. Copying leaves the
  note and current selection unchanged.
- Copying also works for empty blocks and blocks without a closing fence.

### Linux process name

- AppImage builds now appear as `emerald` in system monitors and process lists
  instead of `AppRun.wrapped`.
- Opening Markdown files from the command line or desktop continues to work,
  including file paths containing spaces or Unicode characters.

### Testing notes

- In Edit Mode, copy a code block that extends below the viewport and paste it
  into another document. Confirm that every line and its whitespace survive.
- On Linux, launch this AppImage and confirm its process is named `emerald`.

### Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux (x86-64) | `Emerald-x86_64.AppImage` | `chmod +x` and run |
| Linux (ARM64) | `Emerald-aarch64.AppImage` | requires glibc 2.39 or newer |
| macOS (universal) | `Emerald-macOS.dmg` | drag to Applications; first launch **right-click → Open → Open** |
| Windows | `Emerald-win64-setup.exe` | installer with Markdown **Open with** registration |
| Windows portable | `Emerald-win64.zip` | extract and run `emerald.exe` |
